$P$ has $\ge 2$ factorizations, so $P$ is ambiguous.

| 12 | $(3,9)\to 27=3^3$ | No |
| 13 | $(2,11)\to 22=2\cdot11$ | No |

**The only valid sum below 14 is $S = 11$.**

## Step 4: Boyan now knows too

Boyan knows $S=11$. He hears that Ani already knew $S<14$ (so $P$'s factorizations all have sum $<14$). Among the decompositions of 11, only $(2,9)\to 18$ satisfies this. So Boyan also determines $(2,9)$. ✓
